# Extract founder (and reference) sequence from an alignment

Extract founder (and reference) sequence from an alignment

## Usage

``` r
extract_seqs(aln, founder_name, ref_name = NULL, start = 1, end = NULL)
```

## Arguments

- aln:

  alignment

- founder_name:

  Name of founder sequence in the alignment

- ref_name:

  Optional name of reference sequence in the alignment. This can be used
  as input to the `ref_seq` argument in
  [`run_wavess()`](https://molevolepid.github.io/wavess/reference/run_wavess.md)
  (default: NULL, i.e. no reference sequence is returned)

- start:

  start position in alignment

- end:

  end position in alignment

## Value

List of founder sequence and optional reference sequence as character
strings

## Examples

``` r
extract_seqs(hxb2_cons_founder, "B.US.2011.DEMB11US006.KC473833",
  start = 6225, end = 7787
)
#> $founder
#> [1] ""
#> 
#> $ref
#> NULL
#> 
extract_seqs(hxb2_cons_founder,
  "B.US.2011.DEMB11US006.KC473833", "B.FR.83.HXB2_LAI_IIIB_BRU.K03455",
  start = 6225, end = 7787
)
#> $founder
#> [1] ""
#> 
#> $ref
#> [1] "ATGAGAGTGAAGG---------------------------TAGCAAC---AATGAGTCCGAGATCTTCAGACCTGGAGGAGGAGATATGAGGGACAATTGGAGAAGTGAATTATATAAATATAAAGTAGTAAAAATTGAACCATTAGGAGTAGCACCCACCAAGGCAAAGAGAAGAGTGGTGCAGAGAGAAAAAAGA"
#> 
```
